system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:50:49 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 sent 51,000,389 bytes to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30; the connection record shows only 8,922 bytes in the reverse direction.
The available connection record identifies the proxy as the destination but does not identify the external destination or the process responsible for the large client-to-proxy transfer.
A Dropbox updater service process ran as SYSTEM on WS-ICHEN-01 at 13:20 and exited about a minute later; the records do not link it to the later large transfer.
At 14:10, proxy records show ivy.chen using Chrome to access Microsoft Outlook and related Microsoft endpoints, but those records do not establish the destination or purpose of the 13:50 transfer.
The observed volume and direction are consistent with a substantial upload through the proxy, but the available evidence does not establish whether it was malicious or an authorized transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-ICHEN-01 was unavailable from 13:30 through 14:10 UTC, so endpoint process and user activity during that period cannot be assessed from those sensors.
Proxy log collection was unavailable from 13:30 through 14:10 UTC, leaving the external destination, request details, and any proxy attribution for the 13:50 transfer unobserved.
Zeek connection and DNS sensors were reported operational, but the provided connection record does not identify the external destination or initiating process.
claims_not_established: The external hostname or service that received the large transfer.
Which process or application initiated the transfer and what data it sent.
Whether the transferred data was sensitive, business-related, or authorized.
Whether the transfer was initiated by ivy.chen or by software running under another context.
Whether the Dropbox updater or any other unapproved service was involved in the transfer.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve proxy logs, including destination, request or tunnel details, and user attribution, for the 13:50:49 UTC connection and surrounding activity.
Recover endpoint process/network telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 during 13:30–14:10 UTC, including process creation, command lines, and socket-to-process attribution.
Review file access, browser, and cloud-sync records around the transfer to identify any source files or upload operation.
Check DLP, firewall, and destination-side records to determine what was transferred and whether it was authorized.
